(2) B-roll rich-text clipboard fix verified at code level — mdComponentsInline emits inline style='color:#1D9E75' on broll-cue spans and color:#C9956C on scene-header paragraphs, used exclusively by markdownToHtml() which feeds the clipboard text/html payload. 10/10 new backend pytests pass against live preview URL (auth gating, CRUD with persistence, idempotency, 400 on empty voice_id, cleanup, and voice-list regression with 2300+ voices intact).

verified_features.broll_clipboard_inline_styles_code_revie:
PASS via code inspection of /app/frontend/src/components/scripts/SectionCard.jsx: (1) wrapBrollInChildren(children, true) at lines 38-50 emits . (2) mdComponentsInline.p at lines 114-131 detects scene-header via SCENE_HEADER_RE and emits

(3) markdownToHtml() at lines 156-168 wires mdComponentsInline into renderToStaticMarkup, and the copyRichText path at line 204 uses richHtml=markdownToHtml(text) for the clipboard's text/html slot. On-screen rendering inside SectionCard.body continues to use the class-only mdComponents (no inline styles) — the split is correct.
verified_features.scripts_page_loads_clean: PASS — /scripts route loads with zero error elements present in DOM.

critical_code_review_comments: Pickers.jsx VoicePicker remains coupled — the favorites feature is correctly gated to source==='heygen', but the same modal component handles HeyGen + Kokoro pickers via a single 800+ line component. Worth splitting into HeygenVoicePicker + KokoroVoicePicker now that they have diverging feature sets.

Backend /api/studio/voices/favorites endpoints store favorites on the buyers collection — for non-buyer users (admins without a buyer doc), upsert creates a buyer record with source='studio'. That's fine functionally but inflates the buyers admin-list. Consider a dedicated db.user_prefs collection keyed by email so admin Buyers table stays clean.

SectionCard.jsx now carries TWO ReactMarkdown component maps (mdComponents + mdComponentsInline) with near-duplicate code (~75 LOC duplicated between the on-screen and clipboard variants). Refactor by extracting a buildMdComponents(inlineStyle) factory that returns one of the two variants — currently any future fix to li-hoisting logic has to be applied in two places.

B-roll/scene-header colors (#1D9E75 / #C9956C) are inlined as string literals across SectionCard.jsx AND probably duplicated in App.css. Hoist to a small shared constants file (e.g. /app/frontend/src/components/scripts/colors.js) so a single change updates both the on-screen and clipboard payloads.
